protection: When missing departments or users reach either threshold, no changes are written and automatic sync is paused. Check Feishu visibility and preview again before confirming a manual sync.
previewHint: Generate a successful preview within 15 minutes before enabling or changing an enabled schedule. Disabling the schedule does not cancel submitted jobs.
needPreview: Generate a preview without conflicts first
invalid: Enter a valid time and protection thresholds
submitted: Sync submitted. View progress in sync history.
activeTask: An organization sync is pending or running. Preview again after it finishes.
confirmRisk: Missing records reached the protection threshold. Confirm Feishu visibility and these counts: {departments} departments and {users} users will be disabled (including explicit deactivations). This confirmation only applies to the current preview; changed data requires another preview.
risk: Missing records reached the protection threshold. Review the preview before confirming.
previewExpired: Preview expired. Generate a new preview.
statusError: Could not refresh status. Click Refresh records to retry.
readOnly: You may view and preview. Saving or syncing requires user and department update permissions.
